联合公布《人工智能拟人化互动服务管理暂行办法》: Jointly issued the "Interim Measures for the Management of Anthropomorphized Interactive Services of Artificial Intelligence"
本报北京4月12日电 （记者金歆）记者从国家网信办获悉：10日，国家网信办、国: Beijing, April 12 (Reporter Jin Xin) – The reporter learned from the State Internet Information Office that on the 10th, the State Internet Information Office, the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Public Security, and the State Administration for Market Regulation jointly issued the "Interim Measures for the Management of Anthropomorphized Interactive Services of Artificial Intelligence," which will come into effect on July 15, 2026
国家网信办有关负责人表示，《办法》旨在促进人工智能拟人化互动服务健康发展和规范应: A responsible person from the State Internet Information Office stated that the "Measures" aim to promote the healthy development and standardized application of anthropomorphized interactive services of artificial intelligence, safeguard national security and public interests of society, and protect the legitimate rights and interests of citizens, legal entities, and other organizations
近年来，人工智能拟人化互动服务快速发展，在文化传播、适幼照护、适老陪伴等领域的创: In recent years, anthropomorphized interactive services of artificial intelligence have developed rapidly, with innovative applications continuously emerging in the fields of cultural dissemination, child care, and elderly companionship
出台《办法》，既是促进人工智能拟人化互动服务健康发展的重要要求，也是防范有关安全: The promulgation of the "Measures" is both an important requirement for promoting the healthy development of anthropomorphized interactive services of artificial intelligence and a practical necessity for preventing relevant security risks
《办法》践行以人为本、智能向善的理念，明确国家坚持发展和安全并重、促进创新和依法: The "Measures" embodies the philosophy of human-centered development and intelligent benevolence, clarifying that the state upholds the principle of equally emphasizing development and security and combining innovation promotion with law-based governance, encouraging innovation and development of anthropomorphized interactive services of artificial intelligence, and implementing inclusive, prudent, and differentiated management of such services
提出人工智能拟人化互动服务促进措施，明确支持技术研发创新，鼓励有序拓展文化传播、: Sets forth measures to promote anthropomorphized interactive services of artificial intelligence, clarifying support for technological research and innovation, and encouraging orderly expansion of applications in areas such as cultural dissemination and elderly companionship
规定提供人工智能拟人化互动服务的基本要求，明确不得从事生成危害国家安全、荣誉和利: Establishes basic requirements for providing anthropomorphized interactive services of artificial intelligence, clarifying that such services must not engage in activities generating content that endangers national security, honor, and interests, incites the overthrow of state power, or promotes the subversion of the socialist system, and stipulates the security management obligations of providers of anthropomorphized interactive services of artificial intelligence
完善网络用户权益保护制度，规定人工智能拟人化互动服务提供者的未成年人、老年人权益: Improves the system for protecting network user rights and interests, stipulating the obligations of providers of anthropomorphized interactive services of artificial intelligence in protecting the rights and interests of minors and elderly people as well as personal information protection
此外，《办法》还规定了安全评估、算法备案、指导推动人工智能沙箱安全服务平台建设等: Furthermore, the "Measures" also establishes systems for security assessment, algorithm registration, and guiding the development of artificial intelligence sandbox security service platforms
国家网信办有关负责人表示，人工智能拟人化互动服务的发展与治理需要政府、企业、社会: A responsible person from the State Internet Information Office stated that the development and governance of anthropomorphized interactive services of artificial intelligence require participation from multiple stakeholders including government, enterprises, society, and netizens, jointly maintaining a healthy internet ecosystem and promoting artificial intelligence to develop in an upward and beneficial direction
